hook: The engineer who built Claude Code just gave a free 28-minute class that beats every $300 prompting course
caption:
The guy who built Claude Code just taught a free class better than most $300 prompting courses 🤯

He covers what most people get wrong: a messy CLAUDE.md, no memory shortcuts, and running one session when you could run three in parallel.

→ what actually belongs in your CLAUDE.md
→ keybindings that save you dozens of clicks a day
→ how to run parallel Claude Code sessions on the same project
→ the memory trick that stops you repeating yourself

Which one are you trying today: parallel sessions or the CLAUDE.md fix? 👇

Follow @aiplaybooks.daily for the Claude Code tricks nobody tells you.
